title: Warp Speed for Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) Vaccines: Why Are Children Stuck in Neutral?
ehr_evidence: This is a viewpoint article synthesizing published literature and public health reports; no primary data source was used.
summary: Viewpoint article advocating for the accelerated initiation of phase 2 clinical trials for COVID-19 vaccines in children, discussing potential direct and indirect benefits, safety concerns, and regulatory pathways.
key_findings: No original empirical results; the manuscript is a narrative commentary.
data_source_type: published literature and public health reports
limitations: narrative viewpoint without primary data analysis
relies on cited literature and public health surveillance data
